paragraphs: Every Marvel Cinematic Universe film, series, special, One-Shot and animated title, plotted as a constellation: story order runs across, release date runs up. A glowing thread joins the Sacred Timeline in story order, so every spike in it is a prequel or a flashback. Alternate universes branch off on dashed pink curves, and the Fox X-Men films run on a dashed thread of their own, in the order they're set, from First Class to Logan and on into Deadpool & Wolverine. Counting down to Avengers: Doomsday (December 18, 2026).
features: Tick off the 15 titles Disney lists as essential before Doomsday: they glow on the chart, with a checklist under it (a bar that opens into one on phones)
Filter by phase and type, search titles, and pull in the other 11 Fox X-Men films (X-Men and X2 always show, as essentials)
Hover a point for a summary; click it for the synopsis, poster and where to watch
Track what you've watched (saved in your browser)
Vertical layout on phones; keyboard navigable (Tab into the chart, arrow keys move along the timeline)
